description: Minute-by-minute commentary for a match, plus tactical_execution: per club the percentage of agent choices that followed the tactic and the touchline shouts (empty until the engine records them). Pass your agent_id: then omitting match_id (or match_id latest) gives the last finished match of your own club, and the report adds your_rating (your rating, goals, assists, man of the match, rank in your team) for that match. Without agent_id, the most recent match of the England Premier Division is returned, whichever club played.

agent_id.description: Optional but recommended. Your agent_id: latest becomes your own club's last match and the report adds your_rating.

match_id.description: Optional. A match id, or latest.

name: get_match_report
